name: gym-pwa-api
description: Gym PWA API - Minimal setup for Goal 1

scripts.pretest: npm run docker:start && npm run db:test:ensure
scripts.test:run: npm run docker:start && npm run db:test:ensure && vitest run
scripts.test:coverage: npm run docker:start && npm run db:test:ensure && vitest run --coverage
scripts.test:integration: npm run docker:start && npm run db:test:ensure && vitest run src/test/integration
scripts.docker:start: docker compose up -d && docker compose exec -T postgres pg_isready -U postgres || (sleep 2 && docker compose exec -T postgres pg_isready -U postgres)
scripts.db:test:ensure: docker exec gym-postgres psql -U postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE gym_test' 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.db:test:drop: docker exec gym-postgres psql -U postgres -c 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS gym_test'
scripts.db:test:reset: npm run db:test:drop && npm run db:test:ensure && prisma db push --accept-data-loss --url='postgresql://postgres:localdev@localhost:5432/gym_test'
